<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def framed(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and 20<=n['pixels']<=40:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return None
print('framed before:',framed(current_frame))

print('after click brush:',framed(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])

action(['DOWN'])

</function>
